requirements.title: IEEE_MIN_NUM ordered, NaN, equal, and signed-zero results
requirements.definition: The result is the lesser numeric argument for ordered unequal inputs, the non-NaN argument for exactly one NaN, a quiet NaN for two NaNs, the common value for equal same-sign arguments, and negative zero for opposite signed zeros.

pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-X-less-than-Y: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X); datatype-supported branch uses X=-2.0 and Y=1.0, initializes result to 7.0, and asserts result==-2.0; unsupported branch skips. Mutate operands so X is greater and the assertion fails.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-Y-less-than-X: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X); datatype-supported branch uses X=3.0 and Y=-0.75, initializes result to 7.0, and asserts result==-0.75; unsupported branch skips. Mutate Y to 4.0 so selection changes.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-one-NaN-returns-other-argum: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_NUM and IEEE_VALUE plus IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X); supported branch evaluates IEEE_MIN_NUM(1.5,IEEE_VALUE(1.0,IEEE_QUIET_NAN)) and the reversed argument order, asserting the finite result 1.5 both times; unsupported branch skips.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-both-NaN-result-quiet-NaN: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_NUM, IEEE_VALUE, IEEE_CLASS, and IEEE_IS_NAN plus IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X); supported branch evaluates quiet/quiet, quiet/signaling, signaling/quiet, and signaling/signaling two-NaN rows, initializes a logical sentinel to false, and asserts IEEE_IS_NAN(result) true for each row, using IEEE_CLASS where available to confirm quiet-NaN class rather than NaN equality; unsupported branch skips.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-equal-same-sign-result: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_NUM and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE; datatype-supported branch evaluates IEEE_MIN_NUM(-2.0,-2.0) and IEEE_MIN_NUM(2.0,2.0), asserts the finite values, and observes the negative result sign with IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE; unsupported branch skips.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-opposite-zero-result-negati: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_NUM, IEEE_COPY_SIGN, and IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE; datatype-supported branch constructs NZ=IEEE_COPY_SIGN(0.0,-1.0), pre-verifies IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(NZ), evaluates IEEE_MIN_NUM(NZ,+0.0) and the reversed order, and asserts result==0.0 plus IEEE_IS_NEGATIVE(result) true; unsupported branch skips. Mutate to IEEE_MAX_NUM to flip the signed-zero oracle.

requirements.title: IEEE_MIN_NUM may choose either same-signed equal operand
requirements.definition: For equal operands with the same sign, the processor may return either operand; the observable value and sign are thereby bounded to that common same-signed value.

pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-equal-same-sign-operand-cho: No portable oracle distinguishes operand identity for same-signed equal finite operands; future fixtures assert the bounded common value and sign under S17.11.23-004 and do not require a particular operand instance.

requirements.title: IEEE_MIN_NUM exception signaling and signaling-NaN treatment
requirements.definition: Signaling NaN arguments signal IEEE_INVALID; except for the both-signaling-NaN case, a signaling NaN is otherwise ignored, not quieted as the selected result, and no other exceptions are signaled.

pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-signaling-NaN-signals-inval: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_NUM and IEEE_VALUE, IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X), and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,X); flag-supported branch runs HALTING-OFF-PREAMBLE(IEEE_INVALID), clears IEEE_INVALID, calls IEEE_MIN_NUM with one signaling NaN in each operand position and with two signaling NaNs, and asserts IEEE_INVALID true for each row; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-single-signaling-NaN-ignore: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X) for IEEE_MIN_NUM and IEEE_VALUE plus IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X); supported branch calls IEEE_MIN_NUM with one signaling NaN and finite 1.0 in both argument orders and asserts the finite result 1.0; unsupported branch skips.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-no-other-exceptions: Guarded plan probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X), IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X), and IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,X) for each non-invalid flag; each flag-supported branch runs HALTING-OFF-PREAMBLE(flag), clears all flags before each row, exercises finite, quiet-NaN in both operand orders, quiet/quiet two-NaN, signaling-NaN in both operand orders, and two-signaling-NaN controls, and asserts the probed non-invalid flag remains false; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MIN_NUM-NaN-payload-and-selected-Na: No portable oracle: NaN payload identity, which NaN operand supplies a quiet-NaN result, and representation changes to an unselected signaling NaN are processor dependent or unobservable in a portable single-image test.
